Date: 2028-05-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: VM evidence and remediation timeline for CVE-2027-4821

Hi Tessa,

Quick ask from our security/audit team as we prepare for a SIG+SOC2 follow-up: can you provide evidence for your vulnerability management cadence and remediation for the kernel compression issue (CVE-2027-4821) and the related container LZ4 backport (internal tracking CVE-2028-0112 that we flagged in our vulnerability scan)? Specifically:

- Last 6 months of authenticated vulnerability-scan index and the weekly/monthly cadence.
- Proof of remediation for CVE-2027-4821 (dates: discovery → mitigation → verification).
- Any accepted SLA exceptions, compensating controls, or rollback notes (if remediation was staged).
- Contact for your SOC 2 reviewer and link to the SOC 2 evidence binder.

We need the packet by EOD Wednesday (2028-05-22) so the auditor can start cross-checking. If you prefer, a short attestation summary + attachments is fine.

Thanks — Jordan
Security Operations
FinTrust Bank

--
Jordan Patel

- Marissa: attestation draft for my review Tue evening; I'll send final to FinTrust Wed morning and attach artifacts.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter>
To: tessa_morgan, kimberly_park, marissa_cole
Date: 2028-05-21T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: VM evidence and remediation timeline for CVE-2027-4821

Tessa / team — attaching the scan export stubs (see attachments). Highlights from the last 6 months:

- Scan cadence: authenticated infra scans run monthly (1st of month), weekly container image quick-scans on Wednesdays, and critical hotpatch scans triggered ad-hoc for public disclosures.
- CSV attached: vm-scan-index-may-2028.csv (columns: scan_id, target, date, critical, high, medium, low, cve_list).

Specific CVE notes (from remediation log):
- CVE-2027-4821 (kernel compression): discovered 2028-04-10 via routine monthly scan (scan_id: 20280410-INF-07). Initial risk: critical.
  - Mitigation PR opened: 2028-04-12 (cherry-pick + vendor patch integration).
  - Fix deployed to canary fleet: 2028-04-20.
  - Rollout complete to production: 2028-04-28 (18 days from discovery).
  - Post-deploy verification scan: 2028-04-30 (no recurrence). Evidence: cve-2027-4821-remediation-log.pdf (contains changelog, PR links, deployment IDs, verification scan ids).
- CVE-2028-0112 (LZ4 backport issue in third-party container base): flagged 2028-04-15. Vendor backport was delayed; we implemented compensating controls (host-level WAF rule + increased container restart cadence) while vendor patch backport was validated. Exception request form attached: sla-exception-request-lz4.pdf. Final vendor backport rolled into image rebuild and deployed 2028-05-02.

Notes on SLA: our standard internal SLO is 30 days for critical CVEs where we control the binary; 45 days when remediation depends on third-party vendor backports or kernel-level fixes requiring coordinated rollouts. We recorded the LZ4 backport as a documented SLA exception and applied compensating controls until the vendor patch was available.

Attachments (refer to packet): vm-scan-index-may-2028.csv, cve-2027-4821-remediation-log.pdf, sla-exception-request-lz4.pdf

Ben
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan>
To: Jordan Patel <security@fintrust.com>, audit-team@fintrust.com
Cc: ben_carter, kimberly_park, marissa_cole
Date: 2028-05-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrust VM evidence & SLA confirmation

Jordan / FinTrust audit team —

Thank you for the list. Please find our attestation below and the requested artifacts attached. Ben and Kim have validated the logs and we have included the SOC 2 evidence binder link for your auditor.

Short attestation: Redwood Inference conducts authenticated infrastructure vulnerability scans monthly and weekly image-level quick-scans. For the last 6 months we have maintained that cadence and tracked findings in our scan index (attached). For the specific items you called out:

- CVE-2027-4821 (kernel compression): discovered 2028-04-10, fix deployed across production by 2028-04-28; verification scan completed 2028-04-30. Evidence of discovery, PRs, deployment ids, and verification scan ids are included in cve-2027-4821-remediation-log.pdf.

- CVE-2028-0112 (third-party LZ4 backport): vendor backport was delayed; we documented an SLA exception and applied compensating controls (host WAF rule and increased restart cadence) while we validated the vendor image rebuild. The exception request and approvals are in sla-exception-request-lz4.pdf; final patch was deployed 2028-05-02.

SLA note: our internal SLO for self-remediated critical CVEs is 30 days. For third-party or vendor-dependent fixes we apply a documented exception process and target 45 days with compensating controls in place; details are in the exception PDF.

Attached artifacts: vm-scan-index-may-2028.csv, cve-2027-4821-remediation-log.pdf, sla-exception-request-lz4.pdf

SOC2 evidence binder: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/sites/security/FinTrust/scan-index-2028-05
SOC2 auditor contact: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com> (cc'd)

If the auditor needs any additional exports (full deployment IDs, container image digests, or CB event logs), reply and Ben will produce a chained artifact.

Best regards,

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
